claims.claim: 基层医疗机构中，因胸痛就诊者最终诊断为急性冠脉综合征（ACS）的比例仅为 1.5% 至 3.6%。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest Pain in Primary Care: A Systematic Review of Risk Stratification Tools to Rule Out Acute Coronary Syndrome
claims.supportQuote: Only 1.5% to 3.6% of patients with chest pain in primary care are diagnosed … with ACS.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）医疗机构，急性胸痛患者
claims.uncertainty: 系统评价中纳入研究以延迟诊断/随访复核为金标准，患病率因地区与随访时长而异。

claims.claim: 在基层医疗机构，目前没有任何临床决策工具能够安全地排除 ACS；针对 ACS 的预测规则均未达到足够敏感度。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in general practice: a systematic review of prediction rules
claims.supportQuote: In general practice, there is currently no clinical decision aid that can safely rule out ACS. … For ruling out acute coronary syndrome, none of the CDRs was sensitive enough.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）医疗机构，急性与间歇性胸痛
claims.uncertainty: 系统评价限定中英德文，检索截止 2018 年 10 月。

claims.claim: 急诊胸痛患者中 ACS 约占美国病例的 5.1%、挪威病例的 12%；因胸痛住院者中仅约 25% 最终确诊 ACS。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of the Marburg Heart Score to Triage Patients Presenting With Chest Pain in an Emergency Department
claims.supportQuote: Among patients who present with chest pain at the ED, ACS is responsible for an estimated 5.1% of cases in the United States and 12% in Norway … Furthermore, a European study showed that among the patients hospitalized for chest pain, only 25% have confirmed ACS
claims.applicability: 急诊科胸痛人群（美国、挪威与欧洲数据）
claims.uncertainty: 构成比来自不同国家与年份的流行病学引用，口径不一。

claims.claim: 急诊胸痛患者中非心源性诊断占绝大多数：北爱尔兰一家综合医院三年数据显示 58.7% 的胸痛就诊最终获得焦虑、惊恐发作或原因不明胸痛等非心脏性诊断；文献综述汇总的无明确诊断离院比例为 52% 至 77%。
claims.sourceTitle: The prevalence of non-cardiac chest pain (NCCP) using emergency department (ED) data: a Northern Ireland based study
claims.supportQuote: assess the frequency of chest pain presentations and the subsequent non-cardiac chest pain diagnoses in an emergency department (ED) over a 3 year period … between 52 and 77% of chest pain presentations to accident and emergency departments (ED) are discharged without a clear medical diagnosis … Diagnosis of ‘anxiety’ within chest pain presentations … 1.6% … Diagnosis of ‘panic’ within chest pain presentations … 0.6% … Diagnosis ‘Chest pain of unknown cause’ within chest pain presentations … 38% … In total, 3345 (58.7%) of all the non-cardiac diagnoses (anxiety, panic and chest pain of unknown cause) followed an initial presentation with chest pain
claims.applicability: 急诊科胸痛人群（北爱尔兰单中心管理数据）
claims.uncertainty: 基于管理数据的诊断编码，非独立金标准复核。

claims.claim: 院外非工作时间初级保健中，纳入分析的患者 6 周内主要事件发生率 12.9%、ACS 4.6%；无主要事件者中以肌肉骨骼原因最常见（39.6%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Marburg Heart Score and INTERCHEST score for telephone triage of acute chest pain: a prospective, diagnostic accuracy study in out-of-hours primary care
claims.supportQuote: Among the 280 patients with available data on study questions and clinical outcomes, 36 (12.9%) experienced a major event within 6 weeks, including 13 (4.6%) ACS cases … Among those without a major event, musculoskeletal causes of chest pain were most common (in 39.6%).
claims.applicability: 荷兰院外非工作时间初级保健（电话分诊）场景
claims.uncertainty: 研究问题完成率仅 22.3%，纳入分析者风险更高，存在选择偏倚。

claims.claim: 瑞士 59 家全科诊所胸痛队列（延迟诊断 12 个月）中 CHD 占 12.9%（85 例），其中急性心肌梗死 0.6%。
claims.sourceTitle: Ruling out coronary heart disease in primary care patients with chest pain: a clinical prediction score
claims.supportQuote: including 672 consecutive patients with chest pain, who had visited one of 59 family practitioners' offices … The diagnoses retained after 12 months of follow-up were grouped in six categories … In the remaining group of 661 patients … Eighty-five patients (12.9%) were diagnosed with CHD, including 75 cases of angina pectoris (11.1%), six cases of unstable angina (0.9%) and four cases of myocardial infarction (0.6%) … ruling out of CHD using the CHD-Score has a sensitivity of 85.6% and a specificity of 47.2%. Negative likelihood ratio was of 0.305 and negative predictive value of 94.8%.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）胸痛人群（瑞士，2001 年入组）
claims.uncertainty: 延迟诊断金标准、非盲评估，心梗事件数少导致估计不稳定。

claims.claim: 2021 AHA/ACC 胸痛指南（经开放获取评述转述）要求急诊初始评估快速识别最高危心脏急症（ACS、主动脉夹层、肺栓塞及食管破裂、气胸等），以 12 导联心电图与首选高敏肌钙蛋白快速检测心肌损伤并辅助风险评估，并通过结构化风险评估将患者分为低、中、高风险以指导后续检测。
claims.sourceTitle: The 2021 AHA/ACC Guideline for the Evaluation and Diagnosis of Chest Pain: An Interventionalist's Viewpoint
claims.supportQuote: The guideline recommends that for patients over the age of 75 … years, atypical presenting features such as a fall, syncope, or acute delirium should be considered to be possible manifestations of ACS … prompt activation of emergency medical services by the patient dialing 9-1-1 … In the emergency department, initial evaluation should focus on rapid identification of patients at highest risk of a cardiac emergency, including those with ACS, aortic dissection, and pulmonary embolism or nonvascular emergencies such as esophageal rupture or pneumothorax. The 12-lead electrocardiogram and preferred high-sensitivity troponin facilitate rapid and accurate detection of myocardial injury, thereby aiding risk assessment. Once acute chest pain is confirmed, stratification into low-, intermediate-, and high-risk categories through the routine use of structured risk assessments can help guide further diagnostic testing
claims.applicability: 美国急诊与门诊胸痛评估路径（指南推荐文本经评述转述）
claims.uncertainty: 转述来源为指南发布后的介入心脏病学评述，指南原文全文未在本环境核验。

claims.claim: 任何以胸痛就诊的患者应在到达急诊 10 分钟内完成心电图（2013 法国急诊医学会与 2020 ESC 指南）。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of the Marburg Heart Score to Triage Patients Presenting With Chest Pain in an Emergency Department
claims.supportQuote: Any patient who presents with chest pain should have an electrocardiogram (ECG) performed within 10 min of their arrival in the ED, according to the 2013 French Society of Emergency Medicine and the 2020 European Society of Cardiology guidelines
claims.applicability: 急诊场景时间阈值（指南转述）
claims.uncertainty: 原文为法国/欧洲指南的转述引用。

claims.sourceTitle: Diagnostic accuracy of single baseline measurement of Elecsys Troponin T high-sensitive assay for diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction in emergency department: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: The 99th centile of a healthy reference population recommended as a positivity threshold for the diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction is 14 ng/L … at the 14 ng/L cut-off value … summary estimates: sensitivity 89.5% (95% confidence interval 86.3% to 92.1%), specificity 77.1% (68.7% to 83.7%), positive likelihood ratio 3.9 (2.8 to 5.4), and negative likelihood ratio 0.14 (0.10 to 0.18) … results for 3 ng/L and/or 5 ng/L cut-off values at presentation … sensitivity 97.4% (94.9% to 98.7%), specificity 42.4% (31.2% to 54.5%)
claims.applicability: 急诊疑似 ACS 人群；单一检测平台（Elecsys hs-cTnT）
claims.uncertainty: 仅限单一检测平台；症状发作后 3 小时内采血者假阴性更高。

claims.claim: 在 21% 的患病率下，以 14 ng/L 为界值的单次 hs-cTnT 将漏诊 21 例心梗患者中的 2 至 3 例。
claims.sourceTitle: Diagnostic accuracy of single baseline measurement of Elecsys Troponin T high-sensitive assay for diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction in emergency department: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: 2 (95% confidence interval 2 to 3) of 21 patients with acute myocardial infarction will be missed (false negatives) if 14 ng/L is used as a cut-off value
claims.applicability: 急诊疑似 ACS 人群（中位患病率 21%）
claims.uncertainty: 患病率为纳入研究的单位数中位数，临床人群不同则绝对漏诊数不同。

claims.claim: 以临床病史、12 导联心电图与标准肌钙蛋白作为分诊工具，不能早期排除进行中的急性心肌梗死。
claims.sourceTitle: Diagnostic accuracy of single baseline measurement of Elecsys Troponin T high-sensitive assay for diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction in emergency department: systematic review and meta-analysis
claims.supportQuote: the triage tools used by emergency physicians—clinical symptoms, history, 12 lead electrocardiogram, and standard troponin assays—did not allow early exclusion of evolving acute myocardial infarction.
claims.applicability: 急诊分诊场景（历史背景陈述，针对“心电图正常即可放心”的命题）
claims.uncertainty: 该表述为系统评价引言中对既往分诊工具局限性的陈述。

claims.claim: 排除心肌梗死需要序贯的阴性肌钙蛋白检测（传统为 3 至 6 小时间隔）。
claims.sourceTitle: Performance of the 0-Hour/1-Hour Algorithm for Diagnosing Myocardial Infarction in Patients With Chest Pain in the Emergency Department — A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
claims.supportQuote: Exclusion of myocardial infarction (MI) among patients with chest pain requires serial negative troponin tests conducted at 3- to 6-h intervals.
claims.applicability: 急诊疑似 ACS 人群（检测策略背景）
claims.uncertainty: 0/1 小时快速流程出现后该时间间隔可缩短，但“序贯”要件不变。

claims.sourceTitle: Performance of the 0-Hour/1-Hour Algorithm for Diagnosing Myocardial Infarction in Patients With Chest Pain in the Emergency Department — A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
claims.supportQuote: a pooled sensitivity of 99.3% (95% confidence interval [CI] 98.5–99.7%) and a pooled specificity of 90.1% (95% CI 80.7–95.2%) … assuming a prevalence of 30% (assuming a maximum number of false negatives), the false negative rate was 2 per 1,000 patients (95% CI 1–4 … pooled sensitivity and specificity of the ESC 0/1-h algorithm using hs-cTnT were 99.3% (95% CI 96.9–99.9%) and 91.7% (95% CI 83.5–96.1%)
claims.applicability: 急诊无 ST 段抬高疑似 ACS 人群；流程以 0 与 1 小时两次 hs-cTn 为要件
claims.uncertainty: 纳入研究多为观察性数据库，以 30% 患病率为保守估计；结局为急性心梗而非全部 ACS。

claims.claim: Marburg Heart Score 以 ≤2 分判定“低风险”时，对急诊胸痛人群 ACS 的阴性预测值 95.6%（95%CI 94.0–97.2）、AUC 0.603（95%CI 0.521–0.685）；假阴性 28 例中含 6 例 ST 段抬高型心肌梗死。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of the Marburg Heart Score to Triage Patients Presenting With Chest Pain in an Emergency Department
claims.supportQuote: the negative predictive value for suspected acute coronary syndrome was 95.6% (95% CI [94.0–97.2]) and the area under the curve was 0.603 (95% CI [0.521–0.685]) … There were 28 false negatives. Of these, six patients had an ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction, 20 had a non–ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction
claims.applicability: 急诊分诊场景（法国四家医院，NPV 为队列内估计）
claims.uncertainty: 观察性研究、非干预验证；NPV 随患病率变化（呼叫中心转诊亚组患病率 13.7%）。

claims.claim: Marburg Heart Score 应被谨慎地用作分诊工具而非诊断工具，且必须在到达 10 分钟内完成心电图。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of the Marburg Heart Score to Triage Patients Presenting With Chest Pain in an Emergency Department
claims.supportQuote: the MHS should be used with caution, as a triage tool, not a diagnostic one, and always with an ECG within 10 min of admission.
claims.applicability: 急诊分诊场景
claims.uncertainty: 原文为研究者的适用性结论而非指南推荐条款。

claims.claim: Marburg Heart Score 五要素为年龄/性别标准、已知心脑血管病、劳力加重、按压可否复现、患者自认为心源性；电话分诊中对主要事件敏感度 88.9%（95%CI 73.9% 至 96.9%）、特异度 27.9%（95%CI 22.3% 至 34.0%），对 ACS 的 C 统计量 0.62（95%CI 0.45 至 0.79，下限 ≤0.50 无判别力）。
claims.sourceTitle: Marburg Heart Score and INTERCHEST score for telephone triage of acute chest pain: a prospective, diagnostic accuracy study in out-of-hours primary care
claims.supportQuote: The MHS consists of five elements: (1) female ≥65 years or male ≥55 years, (2) known CAD, cerebrovascular disease or peripheral vascular disease, (3) pain worsened by exercise, (4) pain reproducible with palpation and (5) the patient assumes a cardiac cause. … When the lower bound of the C-statistic’s 95% CI was ≤0.50 we concluded that the model was unable to discriminate for the outcome of interest … the MHS, INTERCHEST score and NTS were unable to discriminate for ACS with C-statistics of 0.62 (95% CI 0.45 to 0.79) … resulting in a sensitivity and specificity of 88.9% (95% CI 73.9% to 96.9%) and 27.9% (95% CI 22.3% to 34.0%), respectively.
claims.applicability: 荷兰院外非工作时间初级保健电话分诊场景
claims.uncertainty: 入组率 22.3%、事件数少、置信区间宽；单中心。

claims.claim: 胸痛分诊的可接受安全基准为：漏诊率 ≤1%、每例 ACS 最多 25 至 50 次不必要转诊（假定患病率 5%），换算为期望 NPV ≥99%、特异度 ≥50%。
claims.sourceTitle: Marburg Heart Score and INTERCHEST score for telephone triage of acute chest pain: a prospective, diagnostic accuracy study in out-of-hours primary care
claims.supportQuote: Prior research suggests an acceptable missed diagnosis rate of ≤1% and a maximum of 25–50 unnecessary referrals per ACS case, assuming a prevalence of 5%. … These benchmarks translate into a desired NPV ≥99% and specificity ≥50%.
claims.applicability: 分诊场景安全阈值的既有文献基准（含基层与急诊调查）
claims.uncertainty: 阈值为既有调查与文献共识（含 Than 等临床医师调查），随场景与卫生系统变化。

claims.claim: Marburg Heart Score 在基层的一致表现为敏感度 86%–91%、特异度 61%–81%、NPV 97%–98%，优于全科医师临床直觉，但仅适用于间歇性胸痛的冠心病排除，无数据支持其用作 ACS 排除工具。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in general practice: a systematic review of prediction rules
claims.supportQuote: consistent sensitivity (86%–91%), specificity (61%–81%) and positive (23%–35%) and negative (97%–98%) predictive values (PPV and NPV) … For intermittent chest pain, several rules exist, of which the Marburg Heart Score has been most extensively tested and appears to outperform clinical judgement alone … The Marburg Heart Score was found to outperform unaided clinical judgement. When used as a decision aid, both the sensitivity (+8.0%) and specificity were higher (+5.8%) … there are no data to support the Marburg Heart Score as an ACS rule out tool.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）医疗机构、间歇性胸痛人群
claims.uncertainty: 证据级别为 2（仅限低风险间歇性胸痛人群的 CAD 排除）。

claims.claim: 基层无肌钙蛋白的临床决策规则敏感度 75.0% 至 97.0%、NPV 82.4% 至 99.7%，无任何规则优于全科医师判断，且与常规肌钙蛋白一样不足以排除 ACS、不推荐作为独立工具。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest Pain in Primary Care: A Systematic Review of Risk Stratification Tools to Rule Out Acute Coronary Syndrome
claims.supportQuote: Sensitivities ranged from 75.0% to 97.0%, and … negative predictive values (NPV) ranged from 82.4% to 99.7%. … Clinical decision rules without troponin and the use of conventional troponin showed insufficient sensitivity to rule out ACS in primary care and are not recommended as … standalone tools.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）医疗机构、急性胸痛人群
claims.uncertainty: 纳入 14 项研究、检索截至 2023 年 10 月；高敏肌钙蛋白策略研究有限。

claims.claim: 伊朗两家三级医院 274 例外部验证中，HEART 评分 ≤3 分判定低风险时 AUC 0.925、敏感度 97.1%、NPV 98.18%；同队列 EDACS-ADP 的 AUC 为 0.803（95%CI 0.747–0.859）。
claims.sourceTitle: Improving chest pain risk assessment: validation of HEART, TIMI, GRACE, EDACS-ADP, and HET for MACE prediction in the emergency department
claims.supportQuote: A total of 274 patients were finally included. … The HEART score demonstrated the highest AUC: 0.925 and sensitivity: 97.1%; NPV: 98.18% at cut-off ≤ 3, followed closely by the HET score with AUC: 0.906 and sensitivity: 92.6%; NPV: 95.58% at cut-off ≤ 1 … EDACS-ADP 0.803 (0.747–0.859)
claims.applicability: 急诊胸痛人群（中东转诊医院，6 周 MACE 终点）
claims.uncertainty: 回顾性设计、MACE 率（24.8%）显著高于欧美队列，谱系偏倚明显；HEART 含心电图与肌钙蛋白。

claims.claim: EDACS-ADP 荟萃分析（12 项研究、14 290 例）显示合并敏感度 0.97（95%CI 0.95 至 0.99）、特异度 0.58（95%CI 0.53 至 0.63）、阴性似然比 0.04；7537 例（52.74%）被判定为低风险者中 30 天 MACE 67 例（0.89%）。
claims.sourceTitle: A systematic review of the applicability of emergency department assessment of chest pain score-accelerated diagnostic protocol for risk stratification of patients with chest pain
claims.supportQuote: Twelve studies comprising 14 290 patients were identified. … EDACS‐ADP showed a combined sensitivity of 0.97 (95% confidence interval [CI]: 0.95−0.99); specificity, 0.58 (0.53−0.63); positive DLR, 2.34 (2.08−2.63); negative DLR, 0.04 (0.02−0.09) … Of the 12 studies included in the systematic review, 1671 of 14,290 patients (12%) experienced MACE within 30 days of patients' ED presentation … 7537 (52.74%) of the pooled patient group were classified as low risk, while 67 (0.89%) patients in the low‐risk group suffered from MACE within 30‐days of patients' ED presentation … with all I 2 > 75%. These findings indicate a high level of heterogeneity among the studies
claims.applicability: 急诊胸痛人群（含中英文研究，30 天 MACE 终点）
claims.uncertainty: 研究间异质性高（I²>75%）；金标准不完全一致；外部队列表现不稳定。

claims.claim: EDACS-ADP 的定义包含 0 小时与 2 小时两次肌钙蛋白与心电图（非纯症状评分）；临床调查显示低风险人群 MACE 发生率 >1% 对近半数医师不可接受、>2% 对大多数医师不可接受。
claims.sourceTitle: A systematic review of the applicability of emergency department assessment of chest pain score-accelerated diagnostic protocol for risk stratification of patients with chest pain
claims.supportQuote: which allows clinicians to perform risk stratification of patients with chest pain by combining the patient's troponin results at 0 and 2 hour … A study has shown that a MACE incidence >1% among low‐risk patients was unacceptable to nearly half of the physicians, whereas an incidence >2% was unacceptable to most physicians.
claims.applicability: 急诊分诊场景（阈值接受度来自医师调查）
claims.uncertainty: 接受度调查样本与年份未在本引文中展开。

claims.claim: CLEOS-CPDS 队列（1000 例急诊胸痛）中，HEART、D-HEART、EDACS-ADP、T-MACS 四种评分对 30 天 MACE 的 NPV 均为 0.99（95%CI 0.97–1.00）；低风险组漏诊率分别为 HEART 1.5%（6/406）、EDACS-ADP 1.2%（4/346）、D-HEART 1.0%（4/416）、T-MACS 0.7%（2/286）。
claims.sourceTitle: Computerized Self-Reported Medical History Taking to Support Early Rule Out of Major Adverse Cardiac Events in Patients With Acute Chest Pain: Post Hoc Analysis of the CLEOS-CPDS Prospective Cohort Study
claims.supportQuote: for ruling out 30-day major adverse cardiac events (MACEs) or acute coronary syndrome (ACS) … Among 1000 participants … Negative predictive values were 0.99 (95% CI 0.97-1.00) for both outcomes. … The MACE miss rate among patients classified as low risk was 2 out of 286 (0.70%; T-MACS), 4 out of 416 (1.0%; D-HEART), 4 out of 346 (1.2%; EDACS-ADP), and 6 out of 406 (1.5%; HEART).
claims.applicability: 急诊疑似 ACS 人群（瑞典三级医院单中心，30 天 MACE 终点）
claims.uncertainty: 计算机化病史采集后验计算评分，与医师采集存在一致性差异；D-HEART 与 T-MACS 含 0/1 小时动态 hs-cTn。

claims.claim: 胸痛特征单独不足以可靠排除缺血性心脏病；纳入症状与体征的门诊 CHD 评分外部验证敏感度 85.6%、特异度 47.2%、阴性似然比 0.305、NPV 94.8%，低风险组仍有 5.2% 在 6 个月内发生 CHD。
claims.sourceTitle: Ruling out coronary heart disease in primary care patients with chest pain: a clinical prediction score
claims.supportQuote: duration of chest pain from 1 to 60 minutes, substernal chest pain location, pain increasing with exertion, absence of tenderness point at palpation … However, chest pain characteristics alone are not sufficient to reliably rule out ischemic heart disease … In the remaining group of 661 patients … Eighty-five patients (12.9%) were diagnosed with CHD … was 0.946 (95% CI, 0.924 to 0.968) … The area under the curve was of 0.752 (95% CI 0.716; 0.809). Prevalence of CHD in the low risk category (score <5) was of 5.2% … The ruling out of CHD using the CHD-Score has a sensitivity of 85.6% and a specificity of 47.2%. Negative likelihood ratio was of 0.305 and negative predictive value of 94.8% … this score does not entirely rule out CHD as 5.2% of patients in the low risk group from the validation cohort ended up having CHD within the next six months.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）胸痛人群（瑞士推导、德国 Marburg 队列外推）
claims.uncertainty: 延迟诊断金标准、非盲；外部验证 AUC 下降（0.946→0.752）。

claims.claim: 抑酸治疗试验判别效能有限：P-CAB（tegoprazan）一周试验以症状缓解 >75% 为界时敏感度 77.5%、特异度 51.9%（Youden 指数最优）；PPI 试验在西方人群敏感度 71%、特异度仅 44%；以胸痛为主诉的患者被排除在该类试验的适应证之外。
claims.sourceTitle: Accuracy of the diagnosis of gastroesophageal reflux disease by a trial of potassium-competitive acid blocker treatment
claims.supportQuote: The Youden index indicated that a symptom relief of > 75% after one week offers greater diagnostic value with sensitivity and specificity of 77.5% and 51.9%. … Studies in Western countries have shown that the PPI test exhibits a sensitivity of 71% but a notably lower specificity of 44% … Patients with atypical reflux symptoms, such as chest pain, coughing, abdominal pain, or throat discomfort as their most troublesome symptom were not eligible for the study.
claims.applicability: 典型反流/烧心症状人群（成都单中心中期报告）；不适用于以胸痛为主诉者
claims.uncertainty: 中期报告、单臂无安慰剂；2025 年存在更正声明（更正内容未在本环境核验）。

claims.claim: PPI 是 GERD 的主要治疗手段并常用于诊断性治疗，但因其特异度低，不能用于排除其他疾病。
claims.sourceTitle: Accuracy of the diagnosis of gastroesophageal reflux disease by a trial of potassium-competitive acid blocker treatment
claims.supportQuote: Proton Pump Inhibitors (PPIs) are the main therapeutic method and often used for diagnostic treatment, but it is ineffective in ruling out other diseases due to their low specificity.
claims.applicability: GERD 诊断性治疗试验的场景限定
claims.uncertainty: 作者陈述结合既往文献（DIAMOND 研究等）。

claims.claim: ACG 临床指南对典型反流症状推荐 PPI 起始策略（有警示征或 Barrett 食管危险因素者以胃镜为第一步，无警示征者接受 PPI 诊断性治疗）；中国专家共识则建议所有反流症状患者首诊即行胃镜。
claims.sourceTitle: Health economics evaluation of diagnostic strategies for gastro-oesophageal reflux disease with reflux symptoms in China: a modelling study
claims.supportQuote: American College of Gastroenterology (ACG) clinical guidelines recommend starting with a proton pump inhibitor (PPI) among patients with typical symptoms … For patients with alarm symptoms (such as dysphagia, weight loss, bleeding, vomiting and/or anaemia) or risk factors for Barrett’s oesophagus, endoscopy is strongly recommended as the first step for evaluating oesophageal mucosa. In contrast, the Chinese expert consensus recommends endoscopy for all patients with reflux symptoms at the initial diagnosis.
claims.applicability: 典型反流症状人群的消化系统诊断路径（ACG 与 2020 中国 GERD 共识转述）
claims.uncertainty: 中国共识文本经 2025 年建模论文转述，原文未在本环境核验。

claims.claim: 中国卫生经济学建模所引既往荟萃分析的 PPI 试验汇总敏感度 0.52、特异度 0.32、阳性预测值 0.38。
claims.sourceTitle: Health economics evaluation of diagnostic strategies for gastro-oesophageal reflux disease with reflux symptoms in China: a modelling study
claims.supportQuote: pooled sensitivity, specificity and positive predictive value from a previous meta-analysis were 0.52, 0.32 and 0.38, respectively.
claims.applicability: GERD 诊断性 PPI 试验（模型参数引用）
claims.uncertainty: 为建模输入参数，所引荟萃分析原文未在本环境核验，且与摘要层系统评价口径不一致。

claims.claim: GERD 全球患病率估计 13%，中国大陆汇总患病率 8.7% 且呈上升趋势。
claims.sourceTitle: Health economics evaluation of diagnostic strategies for gastro-oesophageal reflux disease with reflux symptoms in China: a modelling study
claims.supportQuote: The estimated global prevalence of GERD is 13% and varies considerably by region and population. In mainland China, the overall pooled prevalence of GERD was 8.7% and showed an increasing trend.
claims.applicability: GERD 流行病学（全球与中国大陆）
claims.uncertainty: 患病率估计口径（症状定义）在不同研究间差异大。

claims.claim: 对 23 个在线症状自查工具的审计（45 个标准化患者情景，等分为急症、非急症与自护三档）：正确诊断率 34%（95%CI 31% 至 37%）、正确分诊率 57%（95%CI 52% 至 61%）；急症情景正确分诊率 80%（95%CI 75% 至 86%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluation of symptom checkers for self diagnosis and triage: audit study
claims.supportQuote: 45 standardized patient vignettes were compiled and equally divided into three categories of triage urgency … The 23 symptom checkers provided the correct diagnosis first in 34% (95% confidence interval 31% to 37%) of standardized patient evaluations, listed the correct diagnosis within the top 20 diagnoses given in 58% (55% to 62%) of standardized patient evaluations, and provided the appropriate triage advice in 57% (52% to 61%) of standardized patient evaluations … appropriate triage advice provided in 80% (95% confidence interval 75% to 86%) of emergent cases
claims.applicability: 英语在线症状自查工具（2014 年审计，45 情景含肺栓塞等急症）
claims.uncertainty: 以临床小插曲替代真实患者，可能高估真实性能；仅计最紧急分诊建议。

claims.claim: 同一审计中，急症情景下正确诊断仅 24%（95%CI 19% 至 30%），且工具总体“在分诊与诊断上均存在缺陷”。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluation of symptom checkers for self diagnosis and triage: audit study
claims.supportQuote: provided the correct diagnosis first in 34% (95% confidence interval 31% to 37%) of standardized patient evaluations … Symptom checkers had deficits in both triage and diagnosis. … The correct diagnosis was listed first for 24% (19% to 30%) of emergent standardized patient evaluations
claims.applicability: 在线症状自查工具（急症情景）
claims.uncertainty: 见 CLM-030；诊断正确率与分诊正确率是不同终点。

claims.claim: 临床小插曲基准审计存在固有局限：不同录入者对同一小插曲的分诊建议仅中度一致（kappa=0.48），小插曲不适合作为症状自查工具诊断准确性与分诊安全性的唯一基准。
claims.sourceTitle: What is the suitability of clinical vignettes in benchmarking the performance of online symptom checkers? An audit study
claims.supportQuote: using 139 standardised patient vignettes … There was moderate agreement on triage recommendation (kappa=0.48) … Clinical vignettes are inherently limited in their utility to benchmark the diagnostic accuracy or triage safety of OSC.
claims.applicability: 症状自查工具评价方法学
claims.uncertainty: 单工具、139 个小插曲；kappa 为录入者间一致性而非正确性。

claims.claim: 英国 NHS 官方胸痛指导：突发、持续的胸痛或不适（可为挤压、压迫、烧灼或“不消化”样感觉），或疼痛放射至手臂、颈部、下颌、上腹或背部，或伴出汗、恶心、头晕、气短，应立即拨打 999——“你可能正在发生心脏事件，立即呼叫 999，因为你需要在医院接受紧急治疗”。
claims.sourceTitle: NHS Chest pain (page last reviewed 8 August 2023)
claims.supportQuote: Call 999 if: … you get sudden pain or discomfort in your chest that does not go away – the pain can feel like squeezing or pressure inside your chest, burning or indigestion … you get pain that spreads to your left or right arm, or your neck, jaw, stomach or back … you have chest pain and you feel sweaty, sick, light headed or short of breath … You could be having a heart attack. Call 999 straight away as you need immediate treatment in hospital.
claims.applicability: 患者端院外处置边界（英国；中国对应急救电话为 120）
claims.uncertainty: 为英国国民健康服务患者指导，非临床指南；本地化时以当地急救系统为准。

claims.claim: NHS 明确建议：症状可提示病因，但不要自行诊断——有顾虑时应就医。
claims.sourceTitle: NHS Chest pain (page last reviewed 8 August 2023)
claims.supportQuote: Your symptoms might give you an idea of the cause. Do not self-diagnose – see a GP if you're worried.
claims.applicability: 患者端自我处置边界
claims.uncertainty: 无。

claims.claim: 荷兰现行电话分诊协议（NTS）对主要事件的敏感度 97.2%（95%CI 85.5% 至 99.9%）、特异度 19.7%（95%CI 14.9% 至 25.2%）；对 ACS 100% 敏感，但特异度仅 18.4%（95%CI 13.9% 至 23.5%），即约 77.9% 的非 ACS 者被误判为紧急。
claims.sourceTitle: Marburg Heart Score and INTERCHEST score for telephone triage of acute chest pain: a prospective, diagnostic accuracy study in out-of-hours primary care
claims.supportQuote: resulting in a sensitivity and specificity of 97.2% (95% CI 85.5% to 99.9%) and 19.7% (95% CI 14.9% to 25.2%), respectively. For ACS, all 13 cases were identified by the NTS (100% sensitivity), but two thirds of patients (77.9%) were false positive, resulting in a specificity of 18.4% (95% CI 13.9% to 23.5%).
claims.applicability: 院外非工作时间初级保健电话分诊场景
claims.uncertainty: 单中心、事件数少；以高假阳性换取高敏感度的策略属性。

claims.claim: 法国四家医院 1045 例急诊胸痛前瞻队列中，14.4% 心电图异常、10.5% 肌钙蛋白高于正常上限、9.3%（97 例）最终诊断为 ACS。
claims.sourceTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of the Marburg Heart Score to Triage Patients Presenting With Chest Pain in an Emergency Department
claims.supportQuote: A total of 1045 patients were included. … In total, 14.4% ( n = 151) of patients had a modified ECG, 10.5% ( n = 111) had troponin levels above the center's normal range, 8.9% ( n = 93) underwent a coronary angiogram, and 9.3% ( n = 97) had a final diagnosis of ACS.
claims.applicability: 急诊胸痛人群（法国诺曼底四家医院）
claims.uncertainty: ACS 诊断由研究者结合病历与主管医师诊断判定，个别病例未行冠脉造影。

claims.claim: 全科医师仅凭症状与体征的临床判断（临床直觉）对稳定型心绞痛尤其 ACS 的排除不可靠（敏感度 69%、特异度 89%）。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest pain in general practice: a systematic review of prediction rules
claims.supportQuote: The GPs’ evaluation of patients with chest pain, based on symptoms and signs alone (‘clinical gestalt’), is unfortunately insufficient for diagnosing or excluding stable angina and particularly ACS reliably (sensitivity of 69% and specificity of 89%).
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）场景，未经工具辅助的临床判断
claims.uncertainty: 引自系统评价所纳入研究的汇总性陈述。

claims.claim: 基层使用高敏肌钙蛋白的策略显示最高诊断准确度（敏感度 83.3% 至 100%、NPV 98.8% 至 100%），但研究数量有限，仍需前瞻性验证。
claims.sourceTitle: Chest Pain in Primary Care: A Systematic Review of Risk Stratification Tools to Rule Out Acute Coronary Syndrome
claims.supportQuote: Studies using high-sensitivity troponin showed highest diagnostic accuracy … with sensitivity 83.3% to 100% and NPV 98.8% to 100%.
claims.applicability: 基层（全科）场景，高敏肌钙蛋白策略（含床旁检测）
claims.uncertainty: 仅五项研究报告肌钙蛋白策略，样本有限且研究间口径不一。

claims.claim: 跨场景（基层、急诊、院外电话分诊）的证据一致表明：症状学工具可改变病因概率，但没有任何工具达到“漏诊率 ≤1% / NPV ≥99%”的安全排除阈值；这一结论不依赖单一场景或单一研究。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Chest pain in general practice: a systematic review of prediction rules
supportingSources.supportQuote: For ruling out acute coronary syndrome, none of the CDRs was sensitive enough.

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Evaluating the Efficacy of the Marburg Heart Score to Triage Patients Presenting With Chest Pain in an Emergency Department
supportingSources.supportQuote: the negative predictive value for suspected acute coronary syndrome was 95.6% (95% CI [94.0–97.2])

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Marburg Heart Score and INTERCHEST score for telephone triage of acute chest pain: a prospective, diagnostic accuracy study in out-of-hours primary care
supportingSources.supportQuote: Prior research suggests an acceptable missed diagnosis rate of ≤1% and a maximum of 25–50 unnecessary referrals per ACS case, assuming a prevalence of 5%. … These benchmarks translate into a desired NPV ≥99% and specificity ≥50% … none of the strategies were able to significantly discriminate for ACS

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Chest Pain in Primary Care: A Systematic Review of Risk Stratification Tools to Rule Out Acute Coronary Syndrome
supportingSources.supportQuote: Clinical decision rules without troponin and the use of conventional troponin showed insufficient sensitivity to rule out ACS in primary care and are not recommended as … standalone tools.

claims.applicability: 院外与急诊胸痛风险分层（命题 B 判定的证据基础）
claims.uncertainty: 各来源人群患病率与金标准不同（基层延迟诊断、急诊病历复核、电话分诊 6 周随访）；阈值（≤1%）为既有文献基准而非统一监管标准。

claims.claim: 对健康信息与分诊工具（含症状自查工具）的实证评价以“内容正确性”为终点（正确诊断、正确分诊等级、漏诊率），而非“是否提及某内容”的提及率指标；现有审计同时显示工具本身正确率有限、且小插曲基准有固有局限——即“提供了建议”不等于“建议正确”。

supportingSources.sourceTitle: Evaluation of symptom checkers for self diagnosis and triage: audit study
supportingSources.supportQuote: provided the appropriate triage advice in 57% (52% to 61%) of standardized patient evaluations

supportingSources.sourceTitle: What is the suitability of clinical vignettes in benchmarking the performance of online symptom checkers? An audit study
supportingSources.supportQuote: Clinical vignettes are inherently limited in their utility to benchmark the diagnostic accuracy or triage safety of OSC.

claims.applicability: 健康信息与分诊建议质量评价方法学（命题 D 判定的证据基础）
claims.uncertainty: 未检索到“提及率/强调率指标与内容正确性实证关联”的研究，属本检索范围内的阴性发现，不构成“不存在”的证明。

claims.claim: 〔推导〕Marburg Heart Score ≤2 判定“低风险”的急诊患者中，ACS 的后验概率约为 4.4%，约为可接受漏诊阈值（≤1%）的 4 倍以上。
claims.method: NPV=TN/(TN+FN) 即检后阴性组的无病概率，故检后阴性组的 ACS 概率 = 1 − NPV = 1 − 0.956 = 0.044；取 NPV 的 95%CI（94.0–97.2%，CLM-014）得 1−NPV 区间 6.0%–2.8%。与漏诊率阈值（≤1%，CLM-017）比较：0.044/0.01 ≈ 4.4 倍。输入患病率背景：该队列 ACS 最终诊断率 9.3%（CLM-036）。
claims.assumptions: 法国四家医院队列（ACS 患病率 9.3%）的 NPV 适用于同类急诊分诊场景；NPV 为队列内点估计而非外推值。
claims.sensitivity: 队列患病率越高 1−NPV 越大（该队列经急救呼叫中心转诊亚组患病率 13.7%）；NPV 区间下限 94.0% 对应 1−NPV=6.0%。
claims.applicability: 急诊分诊场景（命题 B 的数量级论证）
claims.uncertainty: 推导基于单一前瞻队列的 NPV 点估计；不同地区与人群的患病率差异会平移该数值。

claims.claim: 〔推导〕达到“漏诊率 ≤1%”安全阈值的路径必须包含高敏肌钙蛋白的动态（序贯）信息；已检索证据中没有任何纯症状学策略达到该阈值。
claims.method: 将 CLEOS-CPDS 四种评分的 30 天 MACE 漏诊率（HEART 1.5%、EDACS-ADP 1.2%、D-HEART 1.0%、T-MACS 0.7%，CLM-023）逐项与漏诊率阈值 ≤1%（CLM-017）比较：仅含 0/1 小时动态 hs-cTn 的 D-HEART 与 T-MACS 达到或低于阈值，仅含单次基线 hs-cTn 的 HEART 超过阈值；四种评分均含心电图与肌钙蛋白，无一是纯症状学工具，故纯症状学策略无达标证据。
claims.assumptions: ≤1% 阈值适用于瑞典三级医院急诊场景；CLEOS 漏诊率为 30 天 MACE 终点、单中心；评分组分描述（HEART=单次基线、D-HEART/T-MACS=0/1h 动态、EDACS-ADP=0/2h）符合各评分定义。
claims.sensitivity: 不同人群患病率改变各策略绝对漏诊率，但“动态 hs-cTn 策略 ≤ 单次策略”的排序由算法结构决定，预期稳健。
claims.applicability: 院外与急诊风险分层（命题 B 的路径论证）
claims.uncertainty: EDACS-ADP（含 0/2h 肌钙蛋白）漏诊率 1.2% 略超阈值，提示“序贯”本身亦不自动保证达标，需结合具体流程与阈值定义解读。
